step1_figure.circuit_type: Two-Stage CMOS Operational Amplifier with Cascode Current Sink Biasing
step1_figure.description: The netlist implements the core two-stage CMOS op-amp shown in Figure 24.8 (and Figure 24.2 on page 775). It consists of an NMOS differential input pair (M1, M2) with PMOS active current mirror load (M3, M4) biased by NMOS cascode current sink (M6T, M6B), followed by a PMOS common-source second stage (M7) loaded by an NMOS cascode current sink (M8T, M8B), biased by subcircuit SUB_1.

power_dissipation.description: Total quiescent power dissipated by the op-amp core and biasing network

equation.formula: P = VDD * sum(I_bias) = VDD * (I_M6 + I_M8 + I_bias_network)
equation.explanation: Sum of constant currents drawn from VDD multiplied by supply voltage VDD.
equation.assumptions: Quiescent state with zero differential input voltage.

sky130_expected.calculation: On SKY130 (VDD = 1.8 V), I_M6 = 20 uA (diff-amp tail) and I_M8 = 10 uA (second stage sink). The op-amp core draws 30 uA. Including the SUB_1 bias generator (~6 branches of ~10 uA each, ~60 uA), total current is ~90 uA. P_total = 1.8 V * 90 uA = 162 uW (core alone = 1.8 V * 30 uA = 54 uW).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by branch bias currents set in the reference generator multiplied by 1.8 V supply.

output_swing_high.description: Maximum output voltage before second-stage driver transistor M7 enters triode region

source.reference: Section 'Output Swing and Current Sourcing/Sinking Capability'

equation.explanation: M7 is PMOS; it leaves saturation when VDS7 < VDSsat7 (roughly 100-150 mV across M7).

sky130_expected.calculation: With VDD = 1.8 V and PMOS overdrive voltage VDSsat7 ~ 150 mV: Vout_max = 1.8 V - 0.15 V = 1.65 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Limited by M7 drain-to-source saturation voltage.

output_swing_low.description: Minimum output voltage before the second-stage cascode sink (M8T/M8B) enters triode region

source.reference: Section 'Output Swing and Current Sourcing/Sinking Capability'

equation.explanation: Both cascode NMOS current sink transistors must remain in saturation for high output impedance.
equation.assumptions: Both M8T and M8B require ~100-150 mV across drain-source to stay in saturation.

sky130_expected.calculation: Each NMOS cascode transistor has VDSsat ~ 120-150 mV. Total minimum output voltage = 2 * 0.13 V = 0.26 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Limited by the sum of two NMOS saturation voltages.

max_sink_current.description: Maximum load current the op-amp output stage can sink

source.reference: Section 'Output Swing and Current Sourcing/Sinking Capability'

equation.explanation: Output sinking current is fixed by the constant current sink M8 (M8T/M8B).
equation.assumptions: Output pulled towards ground through constant current sink.

sky130_expected.calculation: Sinking current is biased to 10 uA nominal.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Biased by the cascode current sink M8.

systematic_offset_voltage.description: Input-referred systematic offset voltage caused by device sizing/current mismatch between stages

equation.formula: Vos = V(vp) - V(vm) when Vout = VDD/2
equation.explanation: Input difference required to hold the output at mid-rail under balanced design.
equation.assumptions: Symmetrical layout and matching W/L ratios between stage 1 and stage 2 current mirrors.

sky130_expected.calculation: When M7 and M8 are properly sized to match current ratios (I_M7 = I_M8 = 10 uA at balance), systematic offset is near zero (< 5 mV).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Balanced sizing yields minimal systematic offset.

equation.explanation: Product of first-stage gain (gm1 * R1) and second-stage gain (gm2 * R2).
equation.assumptions: Both stages operate in active/saturation region.

sky130_expected.calculation: gm1 = sqrt(2 * unCox * (W/L)1 * ID1) ~ 150 uA/V; R1 = ro2 || ro4 = 1 / ((lambda_n + lambda_p)*10u) = 1/(0.2 * 10u) = 500 kOhm; Av1 = gm1 * R1 = 75 V/V (37.5 dB). gm2 = sqrt(2 * upCox * (W/L)7 * ID7) ~ 150 uA/V; R2 = ro7 || Rcasn8 ~ ro7 = 1/(0.1 * 10u) = 1 MOhm; Av2 = gm2 * R2 = 150 V/V (43.5 dB). AOLDC = 75 * 150 = 11,250 V/V ~ 81 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Two-stage amplifier gain in 130 nm technology typically achieves 65-85 dB.

dominant_pole_frequency.description: Dominant pole frequency f1 associated with node 1 (Miller compensated)

equation.explanation: Pole at node 1 after Miller multiplication of compensation capacitor Cc.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by Miller multiplication of compensation capacitor across high impedance nodes.

second_pole_frequency.description: Non-dominant pole frequency f2 associated with the output node

equation.formula: f2 = (gm2 * Cc) / (2 * pi * (Cc*C1 + C1*C2 + Cc*C2)) ~ gm2 / (2 * pi * CL)
equation.explanation: Second pole shifted up to higher frequency due to pole-splitting.

sky130_expected.reasoning: High transconductance driving small parasitic and load capacitance.

rhp_zero_frequency.description: Right-half-plane zero frequency fz caused by feedforward through Miller capacitor Cc

equation.explanation: Feedforward current through Cc cancels stage transconductance at fz = gm2 / (2 * pi * Cc).

sky130_expected.calculation: With gm2 = 150 uA/V and Cc = 2.4 pF: fz = 150e-6 / (2 * pi * 2.4e-12) = 9.95 MHz (~10 MHz).

unity_gain_frequency.description: Frequency fun where open-loop magnitude equals 0 dB (unity)

equation.explanation: Unity-gain frequency set by the first-stage transconductance and compensation capacitance Cc.
equation.assumptions: Dominant pole approximation holds up to fun.

sky130_expected.calculation: With gm1 = 150 uA/V and Cc = 2.4 pF: fun = 150e-6 / (2 * pi * 2.4e-12) = 9.95 MHz (~10 MHz).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Direct evaluation of Eq. (24.10) for 10 MHz target.

phase_margin.description: Phase margin indicating stability of op-amp with feedback

equation.explanation: Difference between AOL phase and -180 degrees at unity-gain frequency.

sky130_expected.calculation: With Cc = 2.4 pF and Rz zero-nulling resistor (Rz = 1/gm2 ~ 6.5 kOhm), the RHP zero is eliminated, giving PM ~ 60 degrees.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard compensation design aims for 60 degrees phase margin.

step3_testbench.description: ngspice testbench for op-amp AC frequency response (AOLDC, fun, PM), DC transfer characteristics (output swing, offset), and power consumption.
